title: The Survival Route
pages:
Start here.

Post or snowy village → research station → awakening and first consume → Evolved and convoy → hive and Hydra → Futian pump → underground den.

Use /blacklightguide for a lead based on your own progress.
Search the plains for an abandoned quarantine post. Take the cold-storage record from the booth barrel. Use it in the Overworld to obtain a station map. Keep the copper.

A snowy apprentice cartographer can sell a station map for a base price of 12 emeralds and a compass. At the red X, find the surface entrance and head downstairs.

Next: cold storage
Pass the laboratory and isolation rooms. Open the sample chest beside the ice. Take the virus samples and convoy manifest. The exposed redstone line in the west lab can supply dust for the decoder.

Use a sample aimed at the ground beside you, away from your base. When the vial shatters nearby, switch to Prototype mode. The first release also starts the world's outbreak clock.

Try your first consume

After your first consume and upgrade, investigate the broken quarantine gate. Search the grass and follow fresh tracks onto red soil. Keep its escape route clear. Wild Evolved are another source of ganglia.

Combine the ganglion with copper and redstone dust to make a containment decoder. Read the station's manifest in the Overworld to locate the incident.

Next: the lost convoy

Follow the skid marks to the carrier. Use the decoder on the lock in normal mode. Leave an escape lane by the barrier. If your field notes report a blocked exit, clear the space behind it and restore the floor. The encounter needs a non-Peaceful difficulty.

Bait Goliath into charging the barrier, sidestep and strike the exposed right knee. Follow the weak-point openings, or wear it down with sustained damage. Save the heavy armor core for the pump.

Next: the colossal hive

Explore fresh Overworld terrain for the colossal hive. Break through its defenders and attack the living core in Prototype mode. Collect the living hive tissue and operation intel. One grows a passage; the other identifies the sector to search in Futian.
Save your first tissue for the Hydra passage. Extra tissue goes into syringe culture, building infection cores or the weave nest. See The Supreme Hunter for the separate boss route.

Outside the Blacklight dimension, choose solid ground with two clear blocks above and space away from other Hydras. Use living hive tissue on the top face. Bring five living prey within feeding reach. Keep the area loaded while it grows. Allow at least two loaded minutes.

Approach the mature root to cross into the Blacklight dimension. Bring your intel, armor core and supplies. Use the linked Hydra for the return trip.

Your first lead in Futian

Read the operation intel in the Blacklight dimension. In the indicated Futian sector, look for the black-and-yellow checkpoint. A military disguise lets you inspect dispatch records for the unloading junction and west service entrance.

Alternatively, tail the departing truck from the workshop roof. If you lose it, wait at the post. Investigate its rear while sneaking for circuitry. You can also seize a vehicle or follow the twin tire tracks and hoses on foot.

Activate the pump

Craft a Bloodtox starter with the armor core, military circuitry and redstone. A command key offers a second recipe. Use the starter on the truck in normal mode. Keep the emergence area clear with solid ground.

When the shell falls, approach the kneeling Greene in Prototype mode. Aim at her and press Grab (default E). Once caught, she tears free and slips underground, leaving living tissue behind.

Track the den

Return to Futian after Greene escapes. In a normal world, follow the den marker and its distance even with your weapon out. Look for a way down when you reach it. In superflat, hold Greene's tissue and hold Use to follow spores from your palm.

Check your advancements for the pump encounter. With that milestone, enter the chamber on any difficulty above Peaceful. You can start the fight even if a teammate picked up the only sample or you lost it. Without the sample, search east of the center of a Futian infected district for a passage leading down.

Replay on an older save

Weaken an Evolved to 35% health or less and grab it. While holding it, tap Disguise (default X) to implant it. Face the spider as it feeds. Hold Attack to charge, then release to throw the Evolved into its open mouth. Two feeding-window mouth hits stop it feeding.

While the airborne goddess is casting, hit the straining body part with a charged block throw to interrupt her. When she falls, stand beside the exposed part, press Grab, then Use. Extract her left arm, her right arm, then her head. Finishing the head execution grants Gaze Vacuole to participants.

Select Gaze Vacuole on the utility wheel. Hold its skill key to preview the center up to 40 blocks away. Release to cast. The center stays where you placed it, so a moving target can escape before it closes. Each cast costs 15 biomass and has a five-second cooldown.

Use /blacklightguide to review your current objective and recorded sites. Open the vanilla advancements screen for the Blacklight tree. Read cold-storage and convoy documents in the Overworld; read operation intel in the city dimension.

If a site is already active, return to its existing fight. For an unresponsive lock, check normal mode, the item in your hand, difficulty and the exit space. Search newly generated terrain with structures enabled for natural sites.

If an older save recorded the underground victory at the pump, finish the pump milestone first. In Futian, sneak and hold Use with Greene's living tissue until one full pulse ends. Follow the spores to the underground chamber to replay the goddess fight.
Use the manual to read. Sneak-use to open your field notes: your current objective, recorded destinations and recent discoveries or field feedback. You can also open the notes with /blacklightguide.

Lost your manual? Craft a replacement with one ordinary book and one rotten flesh in any arrangement. You can also enter /blacklightguide without the book to open your field notes and check this character's current lead.
Enter /wiki and click the link in chat to open the Blacklight Wiki. Articles list their game version. Check your field notes for your current objective.

title: Living as a Prototype
pages: After awakening, toggle Prototype mode (default B). Approach a cow, sheep or common infected. Face it, grab (E) and use to consume; attack throws a held creature. Open Upgrades (U) and spend your first evolution points.

Check reach and line of sight. Ordinary targets with under 50 base max health can usually be grabbed immediately; tougher prey generally need to be at 15% health. Mature hosts and bosses have special rules. Switch back to normal mode for tools, chests and books. A lethal hit kills targets with 50 or fewer base HP outright.

Hold the power wheel (Z) to choose a form; change tabs for defenses and senses. Claws pounce, Whipfist reaches out, Hammerfists slam, Muscle Mass improves throwing and Blade pursues a target. Lock on (Tab) and aim for the exposed part.

Buy movement skills, then practise charged jumps, wall running and gliding in open ground. Use in midair for a heavy attack. After learning Bulletdive, hold use during a glide. Sovereign Wings offer a separate flight form. Check bindings for takeoff and descent.

Learn and equip Backspines. Kills accumulate orbiting spines. Lock a target to concentrate a volley; otherwise nearby targets can share it. Invest separately in capacity for a larger stock and duration to retain the stock longer.

Learn Critical Mass and the desired devastator. Consume at full health to build the blue reserve. Fully charge attack + use for Graveyard Spikes, use + grab for Tendril Barrage, or attack + grab for Critical Pain. A short reserve can cost health.

Consume eligible creatures to collect identities. Tap transform (X) to toggle a disguise. Hold it and choose the identity collection to change your selection. Each entry lists its species ability and binding. Collect a military identity before infiltrating dispatch.

Watch for witnesses: attacks or vehicle theft at a checkpoint can raise the alarm. Break sight around corners or on rooftops. Once unlocked, use your defensive and sensory powers to cover an approach or identify infected targets.

Consuming grants biomass and EP, each equal to 25% of the target’s maximum health. Ordinary kills pay half the consumption reward by default. Evolution points purchase skills; biomass powers the nest and death reconstruction. Hold transform and choose the aggregate to shed your shell. Feed to rebuild, or tap transform to return to a safe, loaded shell.

To survive a lethal hit as an aggregate, be infected, enter Prototype mode and keep at least 150 biomass in reserve by default. An ordinary lethal hit spends that reserve. Damage that bypasses invulnerability skips the transformation. Servers can change the cost.

A death aggregate has no shell to recall. Touch living, consumable prey and let the aggregate envelop it. Leave room to stand when you reform. The base lifetime is 45 seconds. Viral Stability I extends it to 75 seconds, II to 120 seconds, and III removes natural decay.

Weaken and consume infected hosts with mature organs to record samples. Check organ research in Upgrades. Sample quality limits the ranks available. Seek older hosts or different organs to advance another line.

Finish the finite base checklist in Upgrades to unlock repeatable core attributes. By default, all six must reach 300 for the first adaptation and regeneration tiers, then 500 for the second tiers. Consult the panel for your server's settings.

With Muscle Mass and a terrain-throw upgrade, hold grab on connected terrain and release to lift it. Hold attack to charge and release to throw; use sets it down. A grabbable creature in front takes priority.

Normal mode uses ordinary hunger. If the server enables Prototype hunger, consuming replenishes food. Keep prey or provisions nearby before a long sprint. Check your active key bindings after rebinding controls.

title: Parasites and Bosses
pages: A Supreme Parasite Syringe can appear in a research sample chest. Culture an existing syringe with a virus sample and two living hive tissues to make two. Keep one for the next culture.

Inject a living Blacklight Hunter, weaken it, then consume it. This cures parasite suppression and unlocks Blade, Armor and Sovereign Wings. Injecting yourself suppresses powers. Injecting a hive instead starts a different encounter.

Bring supplies and clear space around a living hive entity. Inject it with the Supreme Parasite Syringe to release the Supreme Hunter. Back off when the hive bursts. Evade its lunges and punish the recovery after heavy attacks.

Defeat earns the first milestone. For the apex-predator consumption milestone, close in during the kneeling window and finish the consume in Prototype mode. Stop allied attacks or lingering damage from killing it first.

title: Infection and Colonies
pages: The first shattered vial starts the world's outbreak clock; the five stages begin on outbreak days 0, 1, 3, 7 and 14 by default. Servers can change the thresholds. Later stages allow more mature hosts, hunters and airborne infected. Local habitat, loaded chunks and population limits still affect encounters.

City districts track local infection and military presence. Destroying a hive can suppress its neighborhood. Scout another district for hosts or supplies and watch the sky. Use a field scanner to check for nearby infected.

Craft a building infection core with living hive tissue and three rotten flesh. Place it against a supported outer wall. Use an empty hand to inspect growth. Feed the core or leave edible drops where its mouth can reach them. Keep the area loaded.

A mature colony produces infected according to stage and stored nutrients. Several mouths can belong to one hive. An empty reserve, blocked exit or full local population can stall production. For a city portal, plant unprocessed tissue as described in Grow a Passage.

Observe infected hosts feeding and growing. Digestion and competing tissue change the organs, silhouette and abilities. For research, let a useful organ mature, weaken its host and consume it. A plain kill does not register a consume sample.

Hosts can evolve after assimilating multiple distinct mature organs. For the story, follow the escape trail from a quarantine post. Hunt Evolved for a ganglion; raid a hive for living hive tissue. The two materials serve different routes.

After the first vial breaks, look for a split fleshy mound with radiating veins in the Overworld or city. The entrance is a shaft: plan your descent and exit. The central hangar connects to stores, armories and laboratories.
Explore the hatcheries beyond the hangar. Swelling hive entities release defenders; destroying a hive removes that threat. Grow your own two-way passage using living hive tissue.

Common infected are good first prey. Stalkers close in, spitters punish open approaches, while armored beasts and hunters need room to evade. Wild Hydras ambush travelers. Plant and feed a Hydra to establish your own gateway.

title: City Fieldcraft
pages: Explore camps, checkpoints and bases for supply, ammo, armory and technology caches. Military circuitry goes into equipment and mission devices. In Futian you can also intercept the dispatch truck for circuitry.

Use the scanner in normal mode for the name, bearing and distance of the nearest infected within 48 blocks. Move and scan again for other contacts. For story locations use the maps, intel and /blacklightguide.
Choose a weapon, then craft its matching ammunition. Use the carbine or machine gun in normal mode. Heavy launchers and their dedicated rounds are in the following entry.
Each pair shows a launcher and its matching round. Check your stock and clearance before setting out. Military armories are another source of equipment and ammunition.

Use a vehicle item on wide solid ground, then use the hull empty-handed to board. Move to drive and steer, jump to brake and sneak to dismount. Stop and dismount to apply repair parts or compatible ammunition to the hull.

Approach an enemy cab in Prototype mode, sneak and use it empty-handed to attempt a hijack. Witnesses can raise an alarm. Captured vehicles retain damage and ammo. Search base garages and watch for faction supply movements.

On a boardable helicopter, check the pilot seat and rotor clearance. Move to fly and turn, jump to climb, sprint to descend, sneak to leave. An occupied gunner seat handles weapons. The Bloodtox mission belongs to Futian even when exploring other districts or Los Angeles.

title: The Weave Nest
pages: Build a single 5×5 layer: one core in the center, four anchors in the corners, twelve channels along the edges and eight beds inside. Leave level ground along one edge for the operator. The next page can project the arrangement into the world.

0 = Weave Marrow Core
A = Osseous Anchor
B = Offering Bed
C = Vascular Channel

Use the empty core with an empty hand to cycle recipe ghosts. Use each ingredient on its cell's top face to deposit one; use the cell empty-handed to take it back. Quarter-turn rotations work. Keep unused cells clear. Each of the four equipment entries has a 5×5 layout.

As an infected survivor, stand close to an edge at the base level. Sneak-use the rim empty-handed and stand still for about 4.8 seconds. When infusion finishes, ingredients and biomass are spent. Take the result from the core. Moving away cancels the channel.

Each accessory takes one Blighted Wither Core. Hit a wither directly with a Blacklight Virus Ampoule and let the infection take hold before killing it. With mob loot enabled, each infected wither drops one core. Place it in the center cell. The full set takes four.

Cost: 180 biomass. Offer 2 Tissue Fiber, 2 Hive Vein, 2 Living Hive Tissue, 1 Hive carapace, 1 Evolved Ganglion, 1 Blighted Wither Core. Each infected Wither drops one core.

Equip in the chest slot for +25 attack damage. All four add 100 to the opening hit before the infinite Strength multiplier.

Black currents pass over the chest, back and upper arms, fading before changing course.
